C1.rationale: Level 3: Structured communication of complex disciplinary concepts and technical arguments to diverse stakeholders in teacher education.
evidenceLines: critically read academic texts related to education research and identify the main theories and concepts which underpin these texts

Designed for students with a first qualification in a discipline other than education, this course orientates you to the education discipline and provides you with an understanding of concepts and contemporary issues in education and of educational contexts and systems, locally and globally.
